clinic.heroSubtitle: As implant and periodontic specialists, We are dedicated to restoring your smile with advanced dental implants. Our practice excels in providing permanent, titanium-rooted restorations that look, feel, and function like natural teeth, supported by sophisticated technology and compassionate care.

treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation & Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation, including 3D imaging, to assess your oral health, discuss your goals, and create a precise, personalized treatment plan for your dental implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Preparation Work
treatmentJourney.description: If needed, preparatory procedures such as extractions, bone grafting, or gum care will be performed to create a strong, healthy foundation for successful implant placement.

treatmentJourney.title: Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: The titanium implant post will be precisely and surgically placed into your jawbone. We offer various sedation options to ensure your comfort during this procedure.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing and Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: A crucial healing period follows, typically several months, allowing the implant to fully integrate with your jawbone, creating a stable and durable anchor for your new tooth.

treatmentJourney.title: Abutment Placement & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Once integrated, a small connector, called an abutment, is attached to the implant. Impressions are then taken to custom-craft your final crown, bridge, or arch.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Restoration & Care
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom-made crown, bridge, or full arch is securely attached, completing your new smile. We will then provide a long-term care plan to ensure the lasting success of your implants.

faqItems.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqItems.answer: Dental implants can last a lifetime with proper care and maintenance. This includes regular checkups and maintaining good oral hygiene, ensuring their longevity and function.

faqItems.question: How can I get dental implants covered by medical insurance?
faqItems.answer: To explore coverage for dental implants, check if your medical insurance covers procedures related to accidents or specific medical conditions. Contact DoctorPerio for assistance with your claims.

faqItems.question: Why should you avoid dairy after a dental implant procedure?
faqItems.answer: Dairy products might irritate healing gums after a dental implant procedure. It is recommended to limit your diet to soft, non-dairy foods for the first several days to promote proper healing.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate if I have gum disease?
faqItems.answer: While gum disease needs to be addressed, many patients can still be candidates for implants after proper periodontal treatment. We can assess your oral health to determine the best approach.

faqItems.question: Is implant surgery painful and what sedation do you offer?
faqItems.answer: We prioritize your comfort and offer an array of sedation options to ensure a pain-free experience during implant surgery. Our team ensures you feel at ease throughout the procedure.

faqItems.question: What is the typical timeframe for the dental implant process?
faqItems.answer: The entire dental implant process typically involves several stages, from initial consultation to final restoration, and can take several months to allow for proper healing and osseointegration.
